01 Honest Run.goal: The reference behaviour with no faults: when blocks are confirmed and finalized.
01 Honest Run.setup: 4 nodes, 64 honest validators, 200 ms latency, k = 4, c = 2, δ_t = 8.
01 Honest Run.result: Nodes vote as soon as the proposal arrives, about 0.2 s into the slot, and 3/4 of the committee confirm it optimistically within the slot: the confirmed tip is the head. The FG gets a new source after every tick, so every block opens an FG height and the finalized checkpoint runs 2 slots behind the head.

02 Partition 50/50.goal: What an even split does to confirmations, locks and finality, and how the network heals.
02 Partition 50/50.setup: 4 nodes, 64 honest validators, 200 ms latency, k = 4, c = 2, δ_t = 8. Nodes 0–1 and 2–3 are cut apart for slots 48–63.
02 Partition 50/50.result: Each half confirms and fast-locks its own branch (32 votes, exactly n/2), and finality stalls: 32 is below the quorum of 43. After the heal the votes split 32–32, no child of the last common block holds a strict majority, and both branches are discarded: 7–8 confirmed blocks per node are orphaned. Finality returns 13 slots after the heal: every validator already sent its target at the stuck height for its own side's block, so the new chain crosses that height only by timeout, δ_t slots after entering it (5 + δ_t slots for δ_t from 2 to 8).

03 Partition 75/25.goal: A split whose larger side still holds a finality quorum.
03 Partition 75/25.setup: 4 nodes, 64 honest validators, 200 ms latency, k = 4, c = 2, δ_t = 8. Node 3 is cut off from nodes 0–2 for slots 48–63.
03 Partition 75/25.result: The 48-validator side keeps confirming and finalizing through the cut. The lone node confirms its own blocks (a strict majority of the 16 voters it sees) and loses 3 of them at the heal. It catches up with finality 2 slots after the heal. With 16 votes it never passes the fast test during the cut, so its first fast locks after the heal are graded: they live 2, then 3, then 4 slots (the Fast-lock lifetime row of panel 1: side B's line breaks during the cut, then climbs).

04 Partition 52/48.goal: A near-tie: one side with slightly more than half of the validators.
04 Partition 52/48.setup: 4 nodes, 64 honest validators, 200 ms latency, k = 4, c = 2, δ_t = 8. Nodes 0–1 (33 validators) and 2–3 (31) are cut apart for slots 48–63.
04 Partition 52/48.result: Neither side reaches the quorum of 43, so finality stalls. At the heal the 33 side's branch wins and the 31 side loses 7 confirmed blocks. Finality is back 3 slots after the heal.

05 Long Partition 50/50.goal: A 64-slot even split: do old locks or the FG window get in the way of the heal?
05 Long Partition 50/50.setup: 4 nodes, 64 honest validators, 200 ms latency, k = 4, c = 2, δ_t = 8. Nodes 0–1 and 2–3 are cut apart for slots 48–111.
05 Long Partition 50/50.result: The same outcome as the short cut (tab 02): both branches are discarded (28–35 confirmed blocks per node) and finality returns 12 slots after the heal. No lock or finality conflict.

06 Messy Heal.goal: The 50/50 cut of tab 02, with the held messages trickling out over two slots after the heal.
06 Messy Heal.setup: 4 nodes, 64 honest validators, 200 ms latency, k = 4, c = 2, δ_t = 8. Nodes 0–1 and 2–3 are cut apart for slots 48–63; each held message arrives up to 12 s after the heal.
06 Messy Heal.result: The same outcome as tab 02, one slot later: heads agree 4 slots after the heal, 8 confirmed blocks per node are orphaned, and finality returns 14 slots after the heal. No lock or finality conflict.

07 Three-Way Cut.goal: A cut into three groups: half of the validators together, and the other half split in two.
07 Three-Way Cut.setup: 4 nodes, 64 honest validators, 200 ms latency, k = 4, c = 2, δ_t = 8. Nodes 0–1 (32 validators), node 2 (16) and node 3 (16) are cut apart for slots 48–63.
07 Three-Way Cut.result: Every group confirms its own blocks; no group reaches the quorum of 43, so finality stalls. At the heal the half's branch wins: the two single nodes lose 5 and 3 confirmed blocks. Finality is back 3 slots after the heal.

08 One-Slot Glitch at Slot 48.goal: How much finality one bad slot costs.
08 One-Slot Glitch at Slot 48.setup: 4 nodes, 64 honest validators, 200 ms latency, k = 4, c = 2, δ_t = 8. A one-slot 50/50 cut at slot 48.
08 One-Slot Glitch at Slot 48.result: No node locks slot 48's block, yet finality is delayed by two slots and has caught up by slot 52: the FG takes a new source after every tick, so the next slot's fast lock is a source at once. A glitch at slot 49 gives the same.

09 Half the Network Asleep.goal: Half of the validators asleep for 16 slots, then a restart and a rejoin.
09 Half the Network Asleep.setup: 4 nodes, 64 honest validators, 200 ms latency, k = 4, c = 2, δ_t = 8. Nodes 2–3 sleep through slots 48–63.
09 Half the Network Asleep.result: The awake half keeps a confirmed chain (a strict majority of the voters it sees) but cannot finalize. The sleepers restart, join a slot later, and finality is past the wake 4 slots after it. Nothing is orphaned.
